description: The chart illustrates CoLeG-R performance (in percent) for multiple LLaMA-2 model sizes under different SFT (supervised fine-tuning) schedules, shown as grouped vertical bars. The category axis is horizontal and lists three model variants in left-to-right order: LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B. The value axis is vertical, labeled “CoLeG-R (%)”, and uses a linear scale with visible tick labels at regular 10-point intervals (e.g., 10, 20, …, 80), with bars extending into the high-80s range. Each model category contains four adjacent bars corresponding to the legend: a light blue bar labeled “no SFT,” an orange bar with horizontal hatch labeled “+ SFT on D₀,” a purple bar with diagonal hatch labeled “+ SFT on D₀, D₁,” and a solid pink bar labeled “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂.” For LLaMA-2-7B, the bars are approximately ~69 (blue), ~71 (orange hatched), ~82 (purple hatched), and ~85 (pink). For LLaMA-2-13B, the bars are approximately ~78 (blue), ~82 (orange hatched), ~88 (purple hatched), and ~86 (pink). For LLaMA-2-70B, all four bars are near the top of the plotted range, approximately ~88 (blue), ~89 (orange hatched), ~90 (purple hatched), and ~90 (pink). The bars are grouped by model (four bars per model) rather than stacked, and there is no explicit sorting by bar height indicated beyond the fixed left-to-right model order; no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the use of distinct colors and hatch patterns and the legend overlay.
